mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k, or Rank IC drops below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in residential construction starts below 1.2 million units signals weakening housing demand, which reduces household wealth and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 1.5% per annum, combined with a stable CPIAUCSL, indicates a tightening monetary policy that reduces liquidity and raises discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 100.0 (2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing output, which signals a contraction in real economic activity and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of joint-upward instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% combined with rising payroll growth signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A stable or declining CPIAUCSL combined with a rising federal funds rate indicates disinflationary monetary tightening, which reduces real interest rates and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized, combined with falling residential construction, signals a weakening economy, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.
